task.title: Planificar monitoring inputs, backup evidence y update windows
task.shortdesc: Prepare current-state operational evidence para una instancia source-run sin afirmar managed monitoring, official restore automation ni rolling upgrades.

prereq.p: La instancia pasó source readiness y network exposure review, y un administrator o DevOps owner único es responsable de la evaluation window.

context.p: Hasta que existan decisiones de distributions y runtime service, operations planning debe centrarse en observable inputs, manual backup/export evidence y update windows explícitos para un source node.

step.cmd: Liste los monitoring inputs disponibles hoy.

info.p: Registre process status, foreground terminal output, stdout, stderr, GET /health, GET /health/ready, selected API example results, documentation access mediante /help/ y source revision desde git rev-parse --short HEAD.

step.cmd: Recoja backup y export evidence antes de la window.

info.codeblock: mkdir -p backups cp data/bpm.db backups/bpm-pre-update.db sha256sum backups/bpm-pre-update.db
info.p: Exporte también representative Firefox documents como GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/42/firefox/policies.json y guarde la evidence policies.json resultante con checksums.

step.cmd: Programe una stop-the-world update window para source changes.

info.p: Para 0.9.0, planifique one-node downtime antes de git fetch --tags, dependency refresh, alembic upgrade head, make docs-validate y make docs-build. Rolling upgrades are planned but not implemented yet.

step.cmd: Registre gaps como blockers, no como hidden assumptions.

info.note: BPM 0.9.0 no proporciona managed monitoring, automated backup scheduling, official restore automation, point-in-time recovery, managed secrets, token rotation ni rolling upgrade orchestration. Use manual evidence y stop conditions del update runbook.

result.p: El operation plan contiene monitoring inputs, backup/export evidence y una update window realista para current source operation.

postreq.p: Adjunte esta evidence al HA and deferred-boundary record para que futuro distribution work reutilice la checklist.
